description_en: Creates a promotional activity for a broadcast sharing task in the Qlichuanyin service
description_zh: 调用该接口创建千里传音分享任务的促销活动
name: CreateSharePromotionActivity

parameters.help_en: The name of the promotional activity
parameters.name: share_promotion_activity_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the promotional activity, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp). If this parameter is not specified, the promotional activity has no start time limit
parameters.help_zh: 促销活动开始时间的毫秒级时间戳。不传入，表示促销活动没有开始时间的限制
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the promotional activity, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp). If this parameter is not specified, the promotional activity has no end time limit
parameters.help_zh: 促销活动结束时间的毫秒级时间戳。不传入，表示促销活动没有结束时间的限制
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en:
The status code of the call:
If the call is successful, an empty value is returned.
If the call fails, an error code is returned. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh:
调用结果状态码：
调用成功，返回空值。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The ID of the promotional activity

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
